name: autobroker
description: Local-first, provider-agnostic new-car quote pipeline. Full-TypeScript rebuild of AutoBroker around 18 skills.
//ai: Pinned to ^6 deliberately. Do NOT take v7: its LanguageModelV4 spec breaks V3-spec community providers (ts-migration 2026-05-29 D5/D9). CI must ignore the ai major-bump.
//node: Track the latest Active LTS. Node 24 ('Krypton', EOL 2028-04-30) as of 2026-06; with .npmrc engine-strict=true this floor blocks stale Node 22 locally and in CI. Re-evaluate toward Node 26 around its LTS date (2026-10-28).

scripts.ui:functional: pnpm --filter @autobroker/ui run build && for c in harness/cases/*.func.toml; do echo "=== $c ==="; AUTOBROKER_MODE=test MASTRA_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=functional-dummy-not-used pnpm --filter @autobroker/harness run functional -- --case "$(basename "$c")" || exit 1; done
